integrity_statement: All asserted numerical coefficients and volume-limited searches have exact-integer or exact-rational reproducibility checks; generic join and Pick identities are credited as existing literature. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The sharp volume threshold concerns only standard height-one lattice joins of two full-dimensional lattice polygons.
Uniqueness at the minimum refers to polygon Ehrhart-data types up to interchanging factors, not equivalence classes of polygon shapes.
Historical priority cannot be certified from searches or the two full-text primary comparisons alone.
The finite-volume assertion follows from exhaustive exact enumeration over a proved conservative superset; the all-volume sign criterion has an algebraic proof.
title: Sharp Ehrhart-positivity cutoff for joins of two lattice polygons
